designDecision: Section 5 asks for an evaluator-only compositional SemanticClaimFingerprint. Auditing the existing architecture (types.ts's 8 correspondence dimensions A-H, plus the ConflictCode taxonomy) shows that MOST of the listed fingerprint components already exist compositionally, each independently evaluated and independently able to block credit - which is exactly the 'compositional, not a single opaque scalar' design this phase's charter itself demands (Section 5: 'the purpose is NOT exact string equality'). Rather than introduce a second, redundant fingerprint object that duplicates this existing machinery (a needless abstraction with no additional evidence-backed distinguishing power), this artifact FORMALIZES the mapping between the charter's fingerprint components and the existing/newly-added dimensions, and identifies the one genuinely missing component this phase adds (sub-provision identity).

fingerprintComponentMapping.existingRepresentation: semanticFamily field, used as corroborating (never sole) evidence inside C_OBJECT_RESOURCE's family-assisted threshold path

fingerprintComponentMapping.component: economic mechanism / threshold / amount / percentage / ratio / metric

fingerprintComponentMapping.existingRepresentation: Carried inside F_CONDITIONS_EXCEPTIONS' materialDependencies signal; not a separately-scored dimension.
WRONG_TIME_PERIOD conflict code (severity-scoped inside the relevant content dimension, not a standalone dimension).
INCORRECT_SHARED_CAP_RELATIONSHIP conflict code (already implemented in conflicts.ts prior to this phase).

Not independently dimensioned; currently folded into E_ECONOMICS/F_CONDITIONS_EXCEPTIONS evidence where a reclassification changes the applicable basket or metric. No dedicated conflict code exists; disclosed as a documentation gap, not fixed this phase (no reproducible defect evidence exists to justify adding one - see Section 20's own instruction: do not add distinctions without confusion evidence).

referencedDefinedTerms field, used as structural evidence feeding multiple dimensions; not independently scored (a shared defined term alone was already confirmed insufficient for correspondence in Phase 3F.1.5.2's SS16 adversarial case).
H_PROVISION_ROLE_BREADTH dimension + SCOPE_BREADTH_MISMATCH conflict code - makes chapeau-vs-descendant substitution structurally impossible.

contentTerms / overlapDetail() - the lexical-overlap signal underlying C_OBJECT_RESOURCE. Explicitly NOT used for exact-string equality (Section 5's own instruction); used only as a coefficient-and-count-gated corroborating signal.

fingerprintComponentMapping.component: SUB-PROVISION IDENTITY (NEW - the genuinely missing component)
fingerprintComponentMapping.existingRepresentation: I_CLAIM_IDENTITY dimension (NEW this phase) + SIBLING_CLAIM_MISMATCH conflict code - see 03-matcher-remediation.json. This is the ONLY fingerprint component the pre-3F.1.5.3 architecture had no representation for at all: nothing previously checked whether two candidates anchored under the same parent section were the SAME enumerated sub-item or merely SIBLINGS of it.

nineDimensionArchitectureAfterThisPhase: A_SUBJECT_ACTION, B_LEGAL_POSTURE, C_OBJECT_RESOURCE, D_SCOPE_ENTITY, E_ECONOMICS, F_CONDITIONS_EXCEPTIONS, G_OPERATIVE_PROVENANCE, H_PROVISION_ROLE_BREADTH, I_CLAIM_IDENTITY (new). CORE_CREDIT_DIMENSIONS unchanged (A, B, C) - I_CLAIM_IDENTITY is a BLOCKING dimension (added to BLOCKING_DIMENSIONS), consistent with H: it cannot earn credit on its own, but can prevent shared vocabulary from earning it.
notAPackageSpecificEnum: compareClaimIdentity() (claim-identity.ts) operates purely on the STRUCTURAL SHAPE of a sectionRef string (via the already-existing, already-tested splitSectionRef() parser), comparing only whether two references share a parent and differ in their top-level enumerated sub-item. It contains zero package names, document IDs, section numbers, or defined terms - grep-verified in 23-diff-classification.json.
